snippet.title: Delete Giant Threats! Covenant Cards | Part 6: Battlecry & Poison #tcg #cardgame #tcg #ccg #ios
snippet.description:
Welcome to Part 6 of the Covenant Cards Tutorial! 🃏 In "Battlecry & Poison," we’re looking at why this is shaping up to be the best TCG game on mobile by diving into powerful card combos and deep lore.

Learn how to shatter impossible defenses! We'll show you how to use Lethal Injector's Poison to instantly delete a massive Goliath.exe, then follow up with David's Sling's Battlecry for direct, targeted damage to secure your victory. 🎯💀

Missed Part 5? Catch up on Aura & Lifesteal:
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qcIYEnckVe8

Download Covenant Cards on the App Store today and start your campaign: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759227375

If this guide helped you master card synergies, make sure to Like, Subscribe, and hit the bell for more Covenant Cards gameplay! Let us know in the comments: how do you normally deal with massive Taunt walls? 👇
